overview: The paper proposes Curvature-Aware Policy Optimization (CAPO), a reinforcement learning framework that models second-order geometry at the last layer to identify and mask unstable updates, thereby stabilizing policy gradients and achieving significantly higher sample efficiency for LLM reasoning.

modules.name: LLM Reasoning Environment
modules.description: Formulates the next-token generation process as a Markov Decision Process, defining states as prompt-token sequences, actions as token selections, deterministic transitions via concatenation, and an accuracy-based reward function.

modules.name: Math Data Preprocessing
modules.description: Loads and preprocesses mathematical reasoning datasets, formats them into prompts, and handles tokenization for the LLM policy.

modules.name: Last-Layer Surrogate Model
modules.description: Implements the last-layer approximation of the policy network, extracting the pre-softmax weight matrix and feature representations to compute sparse model gradients via Kronecker product formulations.

modules.name: Directional Curvature Estimation
modules.description: Computes the Hessian and Fisher directional curvatures efficiently without materializing the full matrices, exploiting gradient sparsity and Kronecker identities to evaluate prospective objective and policy shifts.

modules.name: Optimizer Step Simulation
modules.description: Models the prospective parameter update step within the last-layer surrogate, supporting stochastic gradient descent and adaptive moment estimation models to simulate updates before execution.

modules.name: Curvature-Aware Data Selection
modules.description: Implements the core CAPO intervention mechanism, evaluating token-level updates using simulated steps and directional curvatures, and applying a trust-region filter to accept or reject samples based on objective and policy shift thresholds.

modules.name: Advantage Estimators
modules.description: Implements advantage estimation strategies, including group relative advantage with group normalization and traditional baseline variants.

modules.name: Policy Gradient Surrogate Objectives
modules.description: Implements the policy gradient loss functions for the actual LLM parameter updates, including clipped surrogate objectives applied only on the data accepted by the selection mechanism.

modules.name: RL Training Orchestrator
modules.description: Manages the overall reinforcement learning training loop, coordinating trajectory generation, step simulation, curvature-aware token masking, and the final gradient update on the LLM parameters.

modules.name: Core Evaluation and Metrics
modules.description: Evaluates the trained LLM policy on mathematical reasoning benchmarks and computes accuracy metrics across different difficulty levels.

modules.name: Stability and Curvature Analytics
modules.description: Tracks and visualizes optimization dynamics during training, including directional curvatures, token rejection rates, and gradient norms, to monitor stability and detect policy collapse.

modules.name: Ablation and Comparison Framework
modules.description: Configures and executes comparative experiments against baselines under conservative and aggressive regimes, as well as ablations on optimizer models and traditional stabilization heuristics.

modules.name: Configuration and Experiment Management
modules.description: Manages hyperparameter configurations, configuration file parsing, and reproducibility settings.

modules.name: Logging and Checkpointing
modules.description: Handles experiment tracking, logs training curves and stability metrics, and manages model checkpoint saving and loading.
